{{Quote|The jungles of Haruun Kal are the galaxy's sole source of thyssel bark, as well as portaak leaf, jinsol, tyruun, and lammas. Among others.''"<br />"''Spices and exotic woods? And these are valuable enough to draw offworld emigrants? Into a war zone?''"<br />"''Have you priced thyssel bark lately?|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint (novel)">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
'''Jinsol''' was an exotic<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Jinsol}}</ref> type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-based spice found only in the [[Tree/Legends|jungles]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. It fetched a very high price offworld, so [[Balawai|prospectors]] would travel there hoping to collect the spice and capitalize on the market. The prices were so high that people would try this amid heavy fighting during the [[Summertime War]] between the planet's tribes, the [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] and the [[Balawai]]. These attempts persisted<ref name="Shatter" /> into [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> when the factions fighting the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began militaristically supporting the tribes and intensifying the local feud.<ref name="Shatter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jinsol was briefly mentioned in [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], a [[2003]] novel by [[Matthew Stover]]. It was unclear as to whether jinsol was a spice for flavoring food or some kind of narcotic [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="Shatter" /> Jinsol later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
